newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Autauga County Board of Education, Ala., $6.250 million capital outlay bonds and $5.5 million capital outlay bonds.
--Chandler, Ariz., $9.7 million general obligation refunding bonds and $5.275 million highway bonds.
--Holland Patent CSD, N.Y., $1.778 million school district bonds.
--Hoosic Valley CSD, N.Y., $6.502 million school district bonds.
--Nassau County, N.Y., $185.365 million general improvement bonds and $4.715 million sewer district bonds.
